newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Child found after six days lost in Argentine jungle.
newsitem.headline: Child found after six days lost in Argentine jungle.

text.p: A three-year old girl lost for six days in a snake-infested Argentine jungle has been found alive suffering little more than a few scratches, police said on Sunday.
Romina Vilarte was found late on Friday just two miles (3.2 km) from her parents' ranch in Misiones province, about 620 miles (1,000 km) north of Buenos Aires.
A team of 50 policemen had slashed their way through the tropical wilderness with machetes for six days searching for Vilarte, who disappeared a week ago Saturday.
According to local media, the police officers who found her reported that she was naked and dehydrated but still managed to ask them for a cookie.
The child was taken to a hospital were she was treated to scratches and insect bites, and then released.
